definitions.explanation: Being or coming very near to something in space or time. A formal word used of locations, objects, and dates, and in technical fields such as sensors and photography.

examples.japanese: ⟦{二|ふた}つ→二つ：02953_futatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{街|まち}→街：17306_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{近接|きんせつ}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The two towns are close to each other.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{本州|ほんしゅう}→本州：18528_honshuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{近接|きんせつ}してきた。
examples.english: The typhoon has drawn close to Honshu.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}{街|がい}→住宅街：09394_juutakugai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{近接|きんせつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{騒音|そうおん}→騒音：03315_souon⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: At factories close to residential areas, noise tends to become a problem.

notes:
Combines {近|きん} (near) + {接|せつ} (touch, adjoin). Being or coming close to something in space or time; a formal alternative to ⟦{近|ちか}づく→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{近接|きんせつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be adjacent to ～
- {近接|きんせつ}⟦{戦|せん}→〜戦：28346_sen⟧: close-quarters combat
- {近接|きんせつ}⟦{撮影|さつえい}→撮影：04175_satsuei⟧: close-up photography

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{隣接|りんせつ}→隣接：14578_rinsetsu⟧: adjoining — specifically sharing a border, right next to
- ⟦{接近|せっきん}→接近：04365_sekkin⟧: approach — emphasizes the movement of drawing nearer
